name: BanglaBlend: Sadhu and Cholito Forms of Bengali Language Dataset
description: BanglaBlend is a curated NLP benchmark dataset comprising 7,350 annotated Bengali sentences categorized into the classical formal Sadhu (Saint) form and the colloquial modern Cholito (Common) form. Preprocessed and cleaned to support style classification, linguistic archaism modeling, and literary text transformation.
